notes: 9B seeds are a locked development replication and seeds 136-145 are the untouched confirmation set. The proposed method uses Gauss-Newton log-parameter covariances, a heteroscedastic Gaussian mixture with BIC-selected unknown K, and soft posterior model personalization. Confirmation is opened only if both development regimes are within 5% of OracleFamily, strictly improve PointK, remain feasible and frozen-stable, and retain fewer shared base models than Local. The same gate then applies to confirmation. ARI is diagnostic, not a gate, because posterior membership is deliberately soft. No privacy is applied.
